# Lamp post with a lantern that swings on its hook (rigid animation, a smooth 2 s loop). Up Z.
new
fps 24
frame range 0 48
add mesh cube --name Post --size 1 --location 0 0 0.9
scale 0.12 0.12 1.8
apply --scale
material new Wood --base-color 0.349 0.118 0.216
add mesh cube --name Arm --size 1 --location 0.22 0 1.72
scale 0.5 0.1 0.1
apply --scale
material assign Wood
# the lantern hangs from a hook at (0.42, 0, 1.66): its origin is put there so it swings about it
add mesh cube --name Lantern --size 1 --location 0.42 0 1.42
scale 0.24 0.24 0.3
apply --scale
material new Glow --base-color 0.941 0.953 0.769 --emission 0.941 0.953 0.769
add mesh cube --name LanternCap --size 1 --location 0.42 0 1.6
scale 0.3 0.3 0.08
apply --scale
material new Iron --base-color 0.349 0.118 0.216
select Lantern LanternCap
active Lantern
join
cursor set 0.42 0 1.68
origin set --to cursor
select Lantern
set rotation 0 -12 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 0
set rotation 0 12 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 24
set rotation 0 -12 0
keyframe insert --channels rot --frame 48
frame set 0
select all
shade flat
export lamp.glb --bake-animations
